calibrate.title: PDF calibration
calibrate.subtitle: Used to work out exact field coordinates in the PDF templates. It is not linked from the app navigation.
calibrate.gridHint: Download a PDF with a 50 pt grid. Read the exact x and y of every form field from it.
calibrate.probeHint: Enter the coordinates and a test string. Download the PDF and check whether the crosshair lands on the right field.
calibrate.howToTitle: How to calibrate a new template:
calibrate.step1: Pick a template from the list above.
calibrate.step2: Press Download with grid, then open the resulting PDF.
calibrate.step3: Read the x and y of every form field off the grid.
calibrate.step4: Enter those values in the X and Y fields and press Download with crosshair to confirm.
